title: BioMarin to Host Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call and Webcast on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 4:30pm ET
body_markdown:
SAN RAFAEL, Calif.


, Oct. 26, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. (NASDAQ: BMRN) today announced that Alexander Hardy, President and Chief Executive Officer of BioMarin, will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ET to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a general business update.


**Dial-in Number**
U.S. / Canada Dial-in Number: +1 833-461-5787
International Dial-in Number: +1 626-884-3620
Conference Call ID: 324 588 583


U.S. / Canada Replay Dial-in Number: +1 833-309-1852
International Replay Dial-in Number: +44 800 007 4044
Playback ID: 324 588 583


Interested parties may access a live audio webcast of the conference call via the investor section of the BioMarin website,[https://investors.biomarin.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4805611-1&h=90991094&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.biomarin.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.biomarin.com%2F) . A replay of the call will be archived on the site for one week following the call.


**About BioMarin** BioMarin is a leading, global rare disease biotechnology company focused on delivering medicines for people living with genetically defined conditions. Founded in 1997, the San Rafael, California-based company has a proven track record of innovation, with nine commercial therapies and a strong clinical and preclinical pipeline. Using a distinctive approach to drug discovery and development, BioMarin seeks to unleash the full potential of genetic science by pursuing category-defining medicines that have a profound impact on patients. To learn more, please visit[www.biomarin.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4805611-1&h=2514950364&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.biomarin.com%2F&a=www.biomarin.com) .
